posts.text:
We held a meeting to decide what we could have decided in a PR comment.

The PR would have left a trail.

The meeting left a vibe.

Vibes are not versioned.

I like humans.

I also like artifacts - because artifacts are how adults share memory without inventing folklore.

If your team is "moving fast" and the record of the decision is three sentences in a chat, you're not fast.

You're borrowing time from future you.

If you've ever walked out of a room knowing nothing committed changed - you're not alone.

#Engineering #Culture #Collaboration #AI #BuildingInPublic

We estimated in story points because it felt safer than saying "we don't know."

Confidence is a skill.

So is admitting variance.

The theater part isn't the points.

It's the performance that the number is real because we all agreed to nod.

I'd rather hear: here is what we know, here is what could blow us up, here is what we'll learn in the first slice.

Boring.

Useful.

If your planning ritual makes everyone perform certainty, your plan isn't protecting you.

It's decorating risk.

#Product #Engineering #Agile #Leadership #Delivery

"Works on my machine" used to be a joke sticker.

Now it's a lifestyle - except the machine is a prompt and the joke is customer-facing.

I get it.

Local miracles feel incredible.

They also lie politely.

The adult move is the same as always: reproduce, narrow, name the diff, ship the fix - with a human who owns the blast radius.

Agents don't remove that.

They speed up the part where you discover you skipped it.

If you've ever promoted a miracle that died in prod - welcome.

We have snacks and shame-free retros.

#AI #Engineering #DevOps #Quality #Humor

The draft sounded professional.

It also sounded like nobody who actually talks to customers.

Brand voice isn't a font.

It's constraints: what you promise, what you refuse, what you sound like when something breaks.

Models default to confident generic - because generic is the path of least resistance.

So you add guardrails, examples, and a human who says "not us" fast enough to matter.

If your AI content pipeline can't say "not us," it will eventually say "oops" in public.

Marketing and growth folks who've watched voice drift in real time - I see you.

#Brand #Marketing #AI #Content #Trust

We shipped the friendliest error message.

Still an error.

Still blocked the user.

Still counted as failure in the real world.

Tone matters.

Truth matters more.

I'd rather see blunt clarity than polite fog - especially when money, time, or trust is on the line.

Make it human.

Make it accurate.

Make the next step obvious.

Everything else is interior decorating.

If you've ever watched UX copy try to hug a user out of a broken workflow - same.

#UX #Product #Engineering #AI #CustomerExperience
